sources.label: Full 1M Paper Text
sources.notes: Source-of-truth full paper text parquet. Runtime retrieval should index chunks and metadata, while TOLBERT training can stream over the full text.

sources.label: P1 Full-Paper Chunks
sources.notes: Derived full-paper chunk examples for contrastive, language-model, and retrieval training.

sources.label: Paper Universe
sources.notes: Paper graph and embedding backbone for retrieval over the 1M paper corpus.

sources.label: Repository Library Exports
sources.notes: Incremental repository graph exports. The exporter can add or refresh repositories as the kernel learns new codebases.

sources.label: TOLBERT Joint v2 Projection
sources.notes: Derived TOLBERT projection. It should be regenerated from the full paper and repository source layers, not treated as the full corpus.

sources.label: Algorithm Catalog
sources.notes: Structured algorithm and problem catalog for coding retrieval.

sources.label: Algorithm Implementations
sources.notes: Concrete algorithm implementations for code retrieval and solution synthesis.

sources.label: Repository/Paper Model Checkpoints
sources.notes: Available trained LoRA/full-model checkpoints produced from the repository and paper libraries. Prefer these for runtime adapters before scheduling retraining.

sources.label: Repository/Paper Model Experiment Specs
sources.notes: Experiment specs for the 32-model paper/repository substrate. These map stored checkpoints back to intended model roles.

sources.label: Digital World Model Checkpoints
sources.notes: Trained planner, verifier, actuator, coder, memory, router, calibration, and world-model assets available for adapter use.

sources.label: TOLBERT Checkpoints
sources.notes: Existing TOLBERT model epochs and retrieval cache. These should be mounted as current trained retrieval assets unless superseded by a full-corpus refresh.
